notes: Latest Landcom annual report discovered from the official corporate-publications page (no hard-coded PDF URL) and archived with SHA-256 outside the repo. The Statement of Comprehensive Income prints an explicit $'000 unit but no single Total revenue or Total expenses subtotal. Total revenue is the exact signed sum of the printed revenue lines (revenue from contracts with customers + other income + finance income) and total expenses is the exact signed sum of the printed expense lines (cost of sales + employee related expenses + other expenses + depreciation and amortisation + net fair value loss on investment properties + finance costs); both are accepted only when the gross-profit, profit-before-tax, net-result and Note 2.2/2.3/2.4/2.5/2.6 bridges reconcile exactly. Every row is a provisional, unverified entity-level SOC statement line (jurisdiction_level=soc, aggregation_role=agency_detail); never add Landcom rows to government program spending, the PNFC benchmark, or any other SOC.
